title: Vocabulary Quiz — Unit 2 Writing: Task 2 essay and quantity words
subtitle: Linking words and essay words from Lesson 4 (Writing Task 2) + countable / uncountable nouns

words.def: as time passes, from the past until now
words.sent: ___, a wide range of food products has become available in shops.

words.def: words that show something happened because of something else
words.sent: There are many ways to produce food. ___, there are many different attitudes towards it.

words.def: words you use to talk about one special case
words.sent: Most people shop to suit their lifestyle. ___, single people may buy frozen food.

words.def: words that introduce a different or opposite idea
words.sent: Some people choose food by price. ___, others care more about quality.
words.coll: on one hand … on the ___ hand

words.def: words that add one more point
words.sent: Some people choose organic food. ___, they worry about how animals are treated.

words.def: words that introduce more exact or surprising information
words.sent: Cost is not an issue for them. ___, very few consumers talk about it.
words.coll: in ___, very few people talk about it

words.def: words you use at the start of the last paragraph
words.sent: ___, it seems that cost is only one of a number of factors.

words.def: a word that links two ideas that seem different
words.sent: ___ some people look at price before quality, others have little interest in it.
words.coll: ___ it is cheap, I don't buy it

words.def: what you think or feel about something
words.sent: There are many different ___ towards food.

words.def: one part of a subject or a situation
words.sent: People consider a range of ___ that include quality and taste.

words.def: a person who buys things
words.sent: Very few ___ talk about the cost.

words.def: one of the things that has an effect on a result
words.sent: Cost is only one of a number of ___ that people take into account.

words.def: how much something matters
words.sent: A great deal of ___ is placed on the freshness of food.

words.def: a subject that people talk about
words.sent: So cost is not an ___.

words.def: to change what someone thinks or does
words.sent: What ___ people when they buy food?

words.def: a part of an essay that starts on a new line
words.sent: An essay should be written in ___, not in bullet points.

words.def: many different kinds of something
words.sent: A ___ food products has become available in shops.

words.vi: rất nhiều (với danh từ không đếm được)
words.def: a lot of — used with words you cannot count
words.sent: In my country, ___ importance is placed on fresh food.

words.def: quite a lot of — used with words you cannot count
words.sent: Others will spend ___ money on food.

words.def: more than enough of something
words.sent: There are ___ ways that food can be produced and sold.

grammar.q: There is a great deal of ___ about healthy food on the Internet.
grammar.note: information không đếm được: không có -s, không có an

grammar.q: Can you give me some ___ on how to stay fit?
grammar.note: advice không đếm được: không có -s, không có an

grammar.q: A large ___ of people eat fast food every day.
grammar.note: a large number of + danh từ đếm được số nhiều

grammar.q: I have very ___ time to cook when I get home.
grammar.note: little + danh từ không đếm được (time)

grammar.q: Technology brings ___ advantages to our lives.
grammar.note: many + danh từ đếm được số nhiều

grammar.q: Only a ___ consumers read the labels on food.
grammar.note: a few + danh từ đếm được số nhiều

grammar.q: Over time, a wide range of products ___ become available.
grammar.note: a range of … — động từ chia theo range (số ít) + present perfect

grammar.q: ___ cost is important, many people put quality first.
grammar.note: although nối hai ý đối lập trong một câu
